added_lines: all the best! we congratulate and warmly welcome into our faith community baby sadie who will be baptised this sunday. may the lord bless her and keep her in his loving care always. these envelopes are now available at the back of the church. all masses on the first friday of the month will be offered for the names on the altar list of the dead. the completed envelopes can be returned to the sacristy or the parish office. altar list of the dead our annual mass of remembrance for parishioners who have died during the past year will take place on wed 18th november at 7.30pm . families of those who have passed away will receive an invitation in the coming weeks. all parishioners are welcome to join us for this special mass, as we come together in prayer and remember our loved ones who have passed away. sat 6.30pm : martin & camel savage, (3a) olive keenan(6a), leo watson(8a) sun 11.30am :), peter ferris(a), deirdre, kevin &sean byrne catherine & eugene callaghan, margie markey & dec members of byrne & markey families, patrick fields(6a) intentions for next week mon 10.00am : dessie farrell (rd) tues 10.00am: wed 10.00am: thurs 10.00am: communion service fri 10.00am : altar list of the dead swords
welcome to st. joseph’s church terenure - south dublin deanery – 29th sunday in ordinary time – sun 18th oct ‘26 email :
phone: 4921755 – parish office hrs: 10am to 1pm (mon, tue, thurs, fri.)fr. dave brannigan phone:

(registered charity no. 20016166) mass: mon, tue, thurs & fri 10am - sat vigil 6pm - sun 10am confession : 5.30-6pm on saturday in confession box or by appointment. mission month october 2026 new voices of hope recently we had a parish pastoral council meeting on the theme ‘the parish of the future’, and one person mentioned they’d like to hear more ‘stories of hope’. so as october is the month of mission, i have asked a number of guest speakers to share on the following theme ‘new voices of hope for mission, shaped by the person of christ’. 1st sunday will begin with sr. ursula agge, a medical missionary of mary sr. from nigeria, whose last mission placement was in tanzania. 2nd weekend of october we will have br. john stretton , an english john of god’s brother doing social work here. 3rd weekend is actually mission sunday weekend, and i have asked fr. doran to share with us some of his faith story then. 4th weekend either myself or rev victor will speak on our experiences as it is the bank holiday marathon weekend, and it might be hard to get here, with all the barriers. 5th and we saved the best for last — our own orla mccarthy, ppc, baptism, partnership, choir, deanery, and dublin diocesan council among other involvement reminding us mission is here, mission is now, and mission is everywhere. maintenance & mission are the two great callings of the church connected by the invitation to evangelise. we hope to have many more stories of hope each october shaped by their faith because we encourage and support each other on the journey. huge thanks to all those who have helped us to begin this exciting faith-filled adventure for st. joseph’s parish. fr. dave brannigan adoration of the blessed sacrament monday-saturday: 7.30am - 9.30am (holy hour for world peace: saturday 8.30am – 9.30am) monday (except bank holidays) and tuesday: 10.30am - 11.30am. monday: 7-8pm. venite adoremus. please note: the parish office will be closed from thursday 29th october and will re-open on the 5th november. svp collection amounted to €1225 last weekend. many thanks for your kind generosity. theway.ie the way.ie is a new digital platform set up by the irish bishops’ conference dedicated to sharing the good news and the witness of the catholic church in ireland. it is intended to help people discover the faith, live the faith and pass on the faith. it is for both seekers and followers. visit
